  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Introduction To Extended Reality Application Development and Digital Twins [IT_4325]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)              Explain the concept of Extended Reality and summarize how it integrates with Digital  
  Twin technology.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)         Differentiate among the four types of modelling used in XR and illustrate their relevance  
  in rendering.                                                                             (3)  
  
  C)         Scenario: You are part of a startup building a remote-training simulator using VR  
  headsets. Analyze the essential hardware components required to achieve realistic          (4)  
  immersion and justify your selection.  
  
  2)              Explain the concept of embodiment and discuss how it affects user presence in the  
  Metaverse.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)         Illustrate how distributed VR architectures enable interaction between multiple users.     (3)  
  C)         Scenario: You are planning a VR training platform for remote teams. Analyze whether a  
  client-server or peer-to-peer architecture would be more efficient and justify your   (3)  
  answer.  
  
  3)              Explain multimodal interaction in XR and identify advantages of gesture-based  
  interfaces.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)         Discuss how graphics, sound, and haptic feedback displays enhance user immersion.          (3)  
  C)         Scenario: In a VR rehabilitation system, users interact with virtual objects using hand  
  gestures. Analyze how navigation and manipulation interfaces can be designed to            (4)  
  maximize comfort and minimize fatigue.

  4)                  Describe multiple-camera tracking and discuss its application in full-body motion  
  capture.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)            Explain how IMU and lighthouse systems improve spatial tracking accuracy.                (3)  
  C)            Scenario: In an outdoor AR exploration app, evaluate how GPS-based tracking  
  compares with SLAM for position accuracy.                                                (3)  
  
  5)                  Explain the role of a game engine in designing virtual worlds and summarize its key  
  components.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)            Demonstrate how scripting in Unity (C#) and Unreal (Blueprint) enhances interactivity  
  in XR applications.                                                                      (3)  
  
  C)            Scenario: You are leading a team developing a mixed-reality educational game. Design a  
  brief approach outlining how physics simulation and animation contribute to an         (4)  
  engaging learning experience.
